text.name: Mayhem Staff
text.description:
{Mayhem Staff}

All destructive spells do 50% more damage.
text.event: "Stop!" - shouted the shaggy goblin, jumping out of the bushes. He pointed some kind of gnarled staff at you: "Give me your gold here, and don't come any closer, this is a dangerous thing!" But as soon as you stepped forward, the goblin ran away with a wild cry, throwing his staff. Picking up the inept bandit's weapon, you realized that it was indeed reckless to go up against a goblin armed with a Mayhem Staff. You can say that you are incredibly lucky!
